
```{r run-scenarios, include=FALSE}
# Every scenario in this table is defined in the pipeline (issue #157):
#   define_scenarios()          WTP and nivolumab-price scenarios
#                               (scenario_analysis.R; the PSA/EVPPI scenario
#                               set run by 12_scenario_EVPPIs.R)
#   dsa_structural_scenarios()  discount rate, time horizon, post-progression
#                               cost, second treatment sequence
#                               (parameter_distributions.R; run by 09_DSA.R and
#                               reported in OWSA.qmd and Table 1), applied here
#                               through the same apply_structural_scenario()
#                               that 09_DSA.R uses
#   define_utility_scenarios()  alternative utilities (scenario_analysis.R)
# All scenarios are run deterministically on the base-case curves.
base_params <- l_params_base

run_scenario <- function(name, params, wtp = WTP, horizon = time_horizon,
                         definition = "") {
  result <- model_fun(params, time_horizon = horizon)
  result <- result[result$Strategy %in% names(strategy_labels), ]
  nmb <- result$Effect * wtp - result$Cost
  data.frame(
    Scenario = name,
    Definition = definition,
    WTP = wtp,
    Strategy = unname(strategy_labels[result$Strategy]),
    Cost = result$Cost,
    QALYs = result$Effect,
    NMB = nmb,
    Optimal = ifelse(seq_along(nmb) == which.max(nmb), "Yes", ""),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

runs <- list()

# 1. WTP and nivolumab-price scenarios (the base case is the first row)
psa_scenarios <- define_scenarios(base_wtp = WTP,
                                  base_c_drug_nivo = base_params$c_drug_nivo)
for (k in seq_len(nrow(psa_scenarios))) {
  params <- base_params
  params$c_drug_nivo <- psa_scenarios$c_drug_nivo[k]
  runs[[length(runs) + 1]] <- run_scenario(
    gsub("\u20ac", "EUR ", psa_scenarios$scenario_name[k]),
    params, wtp = psa_scenarios$wtp[k],
    definition = sprintf("WTP EUR %s per QALY; nivolumab EUR %s per administration",
                         format(psa_scenarios$wtp[k], big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
                         format(psa_scenarios$c_drug_nivo[k], big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE))
  )
}

# 2. Structural scenarios, exactly as 09_DSA.R runs them
structural <- dsa_structural_scenarios(
  base_dr = dr,
  base_horizon_years = time_horizon / 52,
  base_pp_cost = base_params$c_other_pp
)
horizon_models <- list(os = models$best_fit$os, pfs = models$best_fit$pfs)
for (scenario_name in names(structural)) {
  scenario <- structural[[scenario_name]]
  for (side in structural_scenario_sides(scenario)) {
    value <- scenario[[side]]
    applied <- apply_structural_scenario(
      scenario_name, value, base_params,
      base_horizon = time_horizon,
      models = horizon_models,
      strategies_df = strategies_df,
      data_complete = data_complete
    )
    runs[[length(runs) + 1]] <- run_scenario(
      structural_scenario_label(scenario_name, value),
      applied$params, horizon = applied$time_horizon,
      definition = sprintf("%s: %s %s (base case %s %s)", scenario$label,
                           format(value), scenario$unit,
                           format(scenario$base), scenario$unit)
    )
  }
}

# 3. Alternative utilities
utility_scenarios <- define_utility_scenarios()
for (k in seq_len(nrow(utility_scenarios))) {
  params <- base_params
  params$u_np <- utility_scenarios$u_np[k]
  params$u_p <- utility_scenarios$u_p[k]
  params$u_decrement <- params$u_np - params$u_p
  runs[[length(runs) + 1]] <- run_scenario(
    utility_scenarios$scenario_name[k], params,
    definition = sprintf("u_np %.2f, u_p %.2f (base case %.2f, %.2f); source: %s",
                         utility_scenarios$u_np[k], utility_scenarios$u_p[k],
                         base_params$u_np, base_params$u_p,
                         utility_scenarios$source[k])
  )
}

scenario_results <- do.call(rbind, runs)
utility_source_note <- paste(utility_scenarios$source, collapse = "; ")
```

```{r display-table}
display_df <- scenario_results %>%
  transmute(
    Scenario,
    WTP = scales::dollar(WTP, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1),
    Strategy,
    Cost = scales::dollar(Cost, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1),
    QALYs = sprintf("%.2f", QALYs),
    NMB = scales::dollar(NMB, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1),
    Optimal
  )

kable(
  display_df,
  caption = "Table S8: Scenario analyses under alternative assumptions",
  format = "html",
  align = c("l", "r", "l", "r", "r", "r", "c")
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(factor(display_df$Scenario,
                                 levels = unique(display_df$Scenario)))) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      paste0("Base case WTP: EUR ", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY; base-case discount rate ",
             sprintf("%g%%", 100 * dr), "; base-case time horizon ",
             sprintf("%g years", time_horizon / 52), "."),
      "Every scenario is a pipeline definition: WTP and nivolumab-price scenarios from define_scenarios() (scenario_analysis.R), structural scenarios from dsa_structural_scenarios() applied with apply_structural_scenario() (parameter_distributions.R, shared with 09_DSA.R), alternative utilities from define_utility_scenarios() (scenario_analysis.R). All are deterministic runs on the base-case survival curves.",
      "Biosimilar (decreased) nivolumab pricing sets nivolumab to EUR 4,641 per administration.",
      paste0("Literature utilities: ", utility_source_note, "."),
      "Optimal strategy is the highest-NMB strategy within each scenario."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r definitions-table}
definitions_df <- scenario_results %>%
  distinct(Scenario, Definition)

kable(definitions_df,
      caption = "Scenario definitions",
      format = "html", align = c("l", "l")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 11)
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(scenario_results, file = here("tables", "table_s8.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
